a1
Isaac was old and almost blind. He told Esau: bring me game, and cook the dish I love, so I can bless you.
b1
Rebekah overheard, and told Jacob: bring two young goats. Take Isaac the dish, so he blesses you.
b2
Jacob feared a curse, not a blessing. Rebekah said: let the curse fall on me.
b3
She dressed him in Esau's clothes, and covered his hands and neck with goatskin.
c1
Jacob went in: Father, I am Esau. Isaac said: the voice is Jacob's, but the hands are Esau's. And he blessed him.
c2
Isaac said: may God give you dew from heaven and the earth's richness. May nations serve you.
d1
Jacob had barely left when Esau came in. Isaac trembled. Esau cried out bitterly: bless me too, Father.
d2
But the blessing was given. Esau planned to kill Jacob, and Rebekah told Jacob to flee to her brother Laban.
h1
The blessing stood, but the way it was won broke a family.
h2
A lie left one brother grieving, and the other running.
h3
God does not need our deceit. Truth may cost us, but a lie costs more.
h4
Today, choose the truth, even when it is costly.
i
Where is telling the truth costing you right now?
